page.layout: One narrow column of short italic summary paragraphs, each set off by an indent, with the page number printed above it. No running head, no catchword, no signature.; One boxed table of consular lists, years in a right-hand column beside each group; running head above the box; catchword at the lower right.

page.notes: The reading "Northormā" and the macron on "Groningānis" are doubtful; the scan is faint there. "Eusumano" is read from a long-s form and may be a misprint for another spelling. Hyphenation at line ends is kept as printed. Reference marks *, † and ‡ stand beside the years 1582, 1583 and 1584 in the printed right-hand column; they are written in braces at the rows where they appear. The years are printed in old-style figures; the rows beside them are transcribed as the printer set them. Mark positions are approximate.
